review: Local development plans, not a production benchmark. Existing client/principal/project FK indexes and receipt/membership/sequence unique indexes are retained. No redundant FK indexes added. Status/type/date composite indexes need representative institutional distribution and slow-query evidence before adding an explicit migration; leading-wildcard text search cannot benefit from ordinary name B-tree indexes. List query-count regression checks constant queries as row counts grow.
